description: Weibull distribution quantile function lambda (-log(1 - p))^(1/k)

tolerance.reason: p is an exact double, so L = -log1p(-p) is within an ulp or so; raising it to 1/k multiplies that error by 1/k (at most 10 on this grid) and adds an ulp, and multiplying by lambda (a power of two) is exact. 1/k itself is not a double for most k: rounding it (or log(L) / k) costs |log(x/lambda)| 2^-53, at most 744.4 2^-53 = 8.3e-14 at a normal result on this grid (p = 5e-324). 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)
